sd_library.name: KONTAKTS SD Application Library
sd_library.description: Widgets, system wiki/help and offline UPDATE content. Download the ZIP and extract it into the root of the FAT32 SD card; do not flash it to ESP32.

firmwares.name: KONTAKTS Platform / SD Application Library
firmwares.description: Current platform with SYS | SD | WIDGET, hierarchical SD application launcher, Widget Runtime, GitHub OTA/recovery and browser-only SD Help Center.

firmwares.name: KONTAKTS Platform Stable
firmwares.status: PHYSICAL PASS / RECOVERY BASELINE / WEB FLASHER CANDIDATE
firmwares.description: Known-good KONTAKTS platform baseline with firmware-resident STATUS and OTA, persistent filesystem Widget Runtime, NTP clock support, Storage Manager and physically verified live OTA percentage/progress bar. Use this to restore the platform after experimental builds.

firmwares.name: Six-Card Serial Deck
firmwares.status: PHYSICAL PASS / WEB FLASHER PHYSICAL PASS
firmwares.description: Six touch cards with HOME, MEDIA and SYSTEM profiles plus Serial commands.

firmwares.name: Mixed Widgets

firmwares.description: LVGL button, switch, slider, arc, progress indicator and multi-screen navigation.

firmwares.name: Live System Dashboard
